items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know John Pendleton, didn't you? [INTERVIEWER] No, I heard talk about him.

ctx.x: Maybe Ned was his last name. I think it was. I think it was. Because he had a boy working at the Klobel and Derrick. When I was in the saloon business, he used to come in there and I used to give him credit. I can't remember the name.
You know John Pendleton, didn't you?
No, I heard talk about him.
